You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Kite Above the Rooftops",
  "slug": "kite-above-the-rooftops",
  "lang": "en",
  "gameType": "arcade-run",
  "loop": "Tap to make your paper kite rise on the wind, dodge the chimneys, and collect ribbons as the breeze quickens. One crash into a chimney ends the flight.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `arcade-run`

# Arcade run

The world scrolls on its own, the player dodges and gathers, and one mistake ends the run.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `required`    |
| level                | `forbidden`   |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `lose`        |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above at least once: `score` as points change and `end` when the run is over. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden`. A run has no levels, so ramp difficulty with speed instead. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- The only allowed `end` reason is `lose`. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Fairness

A player who does nothing must survive for a few seconds after `start`. Spawn the first hazard well ahead of the player and keep the opening lane clear.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let last = 0,
  running = false,
  paused = false,
  score = 0;
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;
  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt);
    collide();
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
function crash() {
  running = false;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}
```

Keep something moving on screen while idle (clouds, a pulsing prompt) so the run never looks frozen.

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
Here's my plan: build a paper-cut styled kite-flying arcade runner with tap-to-rise mechanics, scrolling chimneys, ribbons to collect, and full bridge/host integration.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kite Above the Rooftops</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #f4ecd8;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

// ---- Setup ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";

let DPR = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
let W = 0, H = 0;

function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.floor(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.floor(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---- Palette ----
const COLORS = {
  bg: "#f4ecd8",
  layer: "#e07a5f",
  accent: "#3d405b",
  highlight: "#81b29a",
};

// ---- Seeded jitter helper ----
function makeJitterSeed(n) {
  const arr = [];
  let s = n * 9301 + 49297;
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    s = (s * 9301 + 49297) % 233280;
    arr.push((s / 233280) * 2 - 1);
  }
  return arr;
}
const jitterTable = makeJitterSeed(777);
function jit(i, amt) {
  return jitterTable[i % jitterTable.length] * amt;
}

// ---- Rounded rect path with jitter ----
function jitterRoundRect(x, y, w, h, r, seedBase) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  const pts = [
    [x + r, y],
    [x + w - r, y],
    [x + w, y + r],
    [x + w, y + h - r],
    [x + w - r, y + h],
    [x + r, y + h],
    [x, y + h - r],
    [x, y + r],
  ];
  // simple jittered rounded rect approximation using arcs at corners
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r + jit(seedBase, 1.2), y + jit(seedBase + 1, 1.2));
  ctx.lineTo(x + w - r + jit(seedBase + 2, 1.2), y + jit(seedBase + 3, 1.2));
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + w + jit(seedBase + 4, 1.2), y + h - r + jit(seedBase + 5, 1.2));
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
  ctx.lineTo(x + r + jit(seedBase + 6, 1.2), y + h + jit(seedBase + 7, 1.2));
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
  ctx.lineTo(x + jit(seedBase + 8, 1.2), y + r + jit(seedBase + 9, 1.2));
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  ctx.closePath();
}

function drawShadowLayer(drawFn) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  drawFn();
  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- Game state ----
let last = 0;
let running = false;
let paused = false;
let started = false; // has boot happened
let score = 0;
let ribbons = 0;
let elapsed = 0;
let speed = 140; // px/s base scroll speed
let level = 1;

const kite = {
  x: 0,
  y: 0,
  vy: 0,
  radius: 18,
  angle: 0,
};

let chimneys = []; // {x, gapY, gapH, w, passed}
let ribbonsList = []; // {x, y, r, taken}
let clouds = [];

const GRAVITY = 480;
const LIFT = -320;
const CHIMNEY_GAP_MIN = 170;
const CHIMNEY_GAP_MAX = 230;
const CHIMNEY_W = 70;
let spawnTimer = 0;
let spawnInterval = 1.7;

function resetState() {
  score = 0;
  ribbons = 0;
  elapsed = 0;
  speed = 140;
  level = 1;
  kite.x = Math.max(90, W * 0.22);
  kite.y = H * 0.4;
  kite.vy = 0;
  kite.angle = 0;
  chimneys = [];
  ribbonsList = [];
  spawnTimer = 0;
  spawnInterval = 1.7;
  // fairness: clear opening lane, first hazard well ahead
  spawnTimer = -2.0;
  initClouds();
}

function initClouds() {
  clouds = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    clouds.push({
      x: Math.random() * (W || 400),
      y: 40 + Math.random() * ((H || 600) * 0.4),
      r: 20 + Math.random() * 30,
      speed: 10 + Math.random() * 15,
    });
  }
}

let booted = false;
let gameOver = false;

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  paused = false;
  gameOver = false;
  resetState();
}

resetState();

// ---- Input ----
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!started) {
    started = true;
  }
  if (!running) {
    if (gameOver) {
      resetState();
      gameOver = false;
    }
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});

function act() {
  kite.vy = LIFT;
}

// ---- Host messages ----
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Spawning ----
function spawnChimney() {
  const gapH = CHIMNEY_GAP_MAX - Math.min(60, elapsed * 1.5) ;
  const gap = Math.max(CHIMNEY_GAP_MIN, gapH);
  const margin = 60;
  const gapY = margin + Math.random() * (H - margin * 2 - gap);
  chimneys.push({
    x: W + CHIMNEY_W,
    gapY: gapY,
    gapH: gap,
    w: CHIMNEY_W,
    passed: false,
    seed: Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
  });
  // maybe spawn a ribbon in the gap
  if (Math.random() < 0.8) {
    ribbonsList.push({
      x: W + CHIMNEY_W + 40,
      y: gapY + gap / 2,
      r: 12,
      taken: false,
    });
  }
}

// ---- Update ----
function advance(dt) {
  elapsed += dt;
  // difficulty ramp
  speed = 140 + Math.min(180, elapsed * 6);
  spawnInterval = Math.max(1.0, 1.7 - elapsed * 0.01);

  // level tracking (speed based, but we cannot emit 'level' per arcade-run - forbidden)
  // NOTE: arcade-run forbids level events, so we do not send them.

  kite.vy += GRAVITY * dt;
  kite.y += kite.vy * dt;
  kite.angle = Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(0.9, kite.vy / 500));

  if (kite.y < kite.radius) {
    kite.y = kite.radius;
    kite.vy = 0;
  }
  if (kite.y > H - kite.radius) {
    kite.y = H - kite.radius;
    crash();
    return;
  }

  spawnTimer += dt;
  if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
    spawnTimer = 0;
    spawnChimney();
  }

  for (let c of chimneys) {
    c.x -= speed * dt;
    if (!c.passed && c.x + c.w < kite.x) {
      c.passed = true;
      score += 1;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    }
  }
  chimneys = chimneys.filter((c) => c.x > -c.w - 10);

  for (let r of ribbonsList) {
    r.x -= speed * dt;
  }
  ribbonsList = ribbonsList.filter((r) => r.x > -30 && !r.taken);

  for (let cl of clouds) {
    cl.x -= cl.speed * dt;
    if (cl.x < -60) {
      cl.x = W + 60;
      cl.y = 30 + Math.random() * (H * 0.4);
    }
  }
}

function collide() {
  // chimneys
  for (let c of chimneys) {
    const kx = kite.x, ky = kite.y, kr = kite.radius * 0.75;
    const withinX = kx + kr > c.x && kx - kr < c.x + c.w;
    if (withinX) {
      const topH = c.gapY;
      const bottomY = c.gapY + c.gapH;
      if (ky - kr < topH || ky + kr > bottomY) {
        crash();
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  // ribbons
  for (let r of ribbonsList) {
    if (r.taken) continue;
    const dx = kite.x - r.x;
    const dy = kite.y - r.y;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < kite.radius + r.r) {
      r.taken = true;
      ribbons += 1;
      score += 3;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    }
  }
}

function crash() {
  if (!running) return;
  running = false;
  gameOver = true;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose", value: score });
}

// ---- Drawing ----
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // clouds - simple paper puffs, always moving for idle liveliness
  for (let cl of clouds) {
    drawShadowLayer(() => {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(cl.x, cl.y, cl.r, cl.r * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    });
  }

  // ground strip of rooftops silhouette
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.15;
    ctx.fillRect(0, H - 14, W, 14);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  });
}

function drawChimney(c) {
  const topH = c.gapY;
  const bottomY = c.gapY + c.gapH;
  const bottomH = H - bottomY;

  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
    jitterRoundRect(c.x, 0, c.w, topH, 6, c.seed);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
    jitterRoundRect(c.x, bottomY, c.w, bottomH, 6, c.seed + 10);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // accent cap bands
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
  ctx.fillRect(c.x - 2, Math.max(0, topH - 10), c.w + 4, 8);
  ctx.fillRect(c.x - 2, bottomY + 2, c.w + 4, 8);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawRibbon(r) {
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.highlight;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const ang = (i / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
      const rad = r.r + jit(i + Math.floor(r.x), 1.5);
      const px = r.x + Math.cos(ang) * rad;
      const py = r.y + Math.sin(ang) * rad;
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  });
  // little tail
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.highlight;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(r.x - r.r, r.y);
  ctx.lineTo(r.x - r.r - 14, r.y + 8);
  ctx.stroke();
}

function drawKite() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(kite.x, kite.y);
  ctx.rotate(kite.angle * 0.3);

  // tail
  ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(-kite.radius * 0.6, kite.radius * 0.3);
  let px = -kite.radius * 0.6, py = kite.radius * 0.3;
  for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
    const nx = px - 10;
    const ny = py + (i % 2 === 0 ? -6 : 6);
    ctx.lineTo(nx, ny);
    px = nx; py = ny;
  }
  ctx.stroke();

  // kite body: diamond shape, paper-cut layered
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const s = kite.radius * 1.4;
    ctx.moveTo(0 + jit(1, 1), -s + jit(2, 1));
    ctx.lineTo(s * 0.75 + jit(3, 1), 0 + jit(4, 1));
    ctx.lineTo(0 + jit(5, 1), s + jit(6, 1));
    ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.75 + jit(7, 1), 0 + jit(8, 1));
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  });

  // inner accent diamond
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  const s2 = kite.radius * 0.6;
  ctx.moveTo(0, -s2);
  ctx.lineTo(s2 * 0.75, 0);
  ctx.lineTo(0, s2);
  ctx.lineTo(-s2 * 0.75, 0);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawHUD() {
  // score plate
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    jitterRoundRect(14, 14, 130, 46, 10, 500);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.font = "bold 22px sans-serif";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("Score " + score, 28, 37);
}

function drawTitleScreen() {
  drawBackground();
  drawKite();

  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    const w = Math.min(360, W - 40);
    jitterRoundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, H / 2 - 90, w, 150, 14, 200);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Kite Above the Rooftops", W / 2, H / 2 - 40);

  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(elapsed * 4);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.font = "bold 20px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
  ctx.fillText("Tap to begin", W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

  ctx.font = "16px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.fillText("Tap to rise, dodge chimneys, catch ribbons", W / 2, H / 2 + 45);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}

function drawGameOverScreen() {
  drawShadowLayer(() => {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    const w = Math.min(320, W - 40);
    jitterRoundRect(W / 2 - w / 2, H / 2 - 80, w, 160, 14, 300);
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.accent;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 26px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Crashed!", W / 2, H / 2 - 30);
  ctx.font = "bold 20px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 6);
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(elapsed * 4);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.layer;
  ctx.fillText("Tap to fly again", W / 2, H / 2 + 44);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}

function drawPauseOverlay() {
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.4)";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 24px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Paused", W / 2, H / 2);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
}

function draw() {
  drawBackground();

  if (!started || (!running && !gameOver)) {
    drawTitleScreen();
  } else if (running) {
    for (let c of chimneys) drawChimney(c);
    for (let r of ribbonsList) if (!r.taken) drawRibbon(r);
    drawKite();
    drawHUD();
  } else if (gameOver) {
    for (let c of chimneys) drawChimney(c);
    for (let r of ribbonsList) if (!r.taken) drawRibbon(r);
    drawKite();
    drawHUD();
    drawGameOverScreen();
  }

  if (paused) {
    drawPauseOverlay();
  }
}

// ---- Main loop ----
function frame(now) {
  const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
  last = now;

  if (running && !paused) {
    advance(dt || 0.016);
    collide();
  } else if (!running && !gameOver) {
    // idle clouds keep moving for liveliness
    elapsed += dt || 0.016;
    for (let cl of clouds) {
      cl.x -= cl.speed * (dt || 0.016);
      if (cl.x < -60) {
        cl.x = W + 60;
        cl.y = 30 + Math.random() * (H * 0.4);
      }
    }
  } else if (gameOver && !paused) {
    elapsed += dt || 0.016;
  }

  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
  last = t;
  draw();
  CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Kite Above the Rooftops", gameType: "arcade-run", lang: "en" });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
